name: Empty state
layerWhy: It stands where content would be; the next step is someone's action.
promise: There is nothing here, this is why, and this is what to do.
expectation: A quiet panel in the content's place with a title, a reason and a button.
evidence: It names the reason and the next step in place.
behaviour: It is announced as a status.
relationships: Its button is the next step.
It is one of the few places a product may show its character: an illustration in empty-art, never instead of the words.
failures: Never a picture instead of words.

inputs: [empty-art]: the product's illustration, above the words (Primal ships none)
